ApplyMapping.description:
``POST /imports/{document_id}/apply-mapping``.

``mapping_id`` (CSV/TSV) names the mapping to read the table with (else
the one whose fingerprint matches); ``account_id`` names the account to
import into (else the document's, the mapping's or, for OFX/QFX/QIF, the
account matched by its last four digits). The caller must be able to
edit the target account. ``group`` (with ``account_id``) names the
statement of a multi-account table the account is for (an
``unknown_account`` item's ``group``); without it a chosen account takes
only the statements with its own last four digits, or the one statement
no account matched. ``statement`` (with ``account_id``) does the same for
the brokerage statements of a document (an investment ``unknown_account``
item's ``statement``: an activity export's account, a PDF's).
``allow_overlap`` names accounts whose statements this run imports
although their period overlaps a statement already imported from
another document (each must be editable); it also takes back a "same
statement" answer: a statement recorded as skipped is imported. Every
re-run also carries the document's "import anyway" and "import as read"
answers from the review queue, each for the one statement it was given
about (``app.domain.imports.statement_answers``). A statement whose
figures do not add up is imported as read only on such an answer, never
by naming its account here.
ApplyMapping.title: ApplyMapping

``POST /budgets``.

``period`` monthly or annual: ``start_date`` is the first day of a month
and there is no ``end_date``; periods are calendar months, or twelve
months from ``start_date``. ``custom``: one period ``start_date ..

``budgeted`` is the line amount; ``carried_over`` what rollover brings
from earlier periods (expense lines of a ``rollover`` budget only);
``available = budgeted + carried_over``; ``actual`` the money spent
(expense) or received (income) in the period; ``remaining = available -
actual``; ``forecast`` the expected actual at the end of the period.
BudgetReportLine.title: BudgetReportLine

``PATCH /budgets/{id}``: absent fields stay; ``lines`` replaces the whole set.

Changing ``currency`` needs ``lines`` in the same request (their amounts

(``succeeded``, ``failed`` or ``dead``). The payload and the last error

JobState.description:
Life cycle of a job row.

* ``running``: leased by ``locked_by`` until ``lease_expires_at``; the
  reaper returns expired leases to ``queued`` (or ``dead``).
* ``succeeded``: finished.
* ``failed``: the last attempt failed and the job is not runnable as is
  (terminal unless re-queued explicitly).
* ``dead``: dead-lettered (``max_attempts`` exhausted or non-retryable).
JobState.title: JobState

MappingCreate.description:
``POST /imports/mappings``.

The header fingerprint comes from ``document_id`` (the server reads the
header row ``spec.skip_rows`` of the document's extracted table) or is
given as ``header_fingerprint``; exactly one of the two.
MappingCreate.title: MappingCreate

MappingSpec.description: How to read one delimited layout (module doc).
MappingSpec.title: MappingSpec

MappingSuggestionOut.description:
The deterministic mapping guess and how far it can be trusted.

``confident`` (no ``doubts``) is what the importer needs to import a
never-seen CSV/TSV layout without asking (INGESTION.md "Parse");
``doubts`` are codes: ``header_not_exact``, ``rows_unreadable``,
``date_order_guessed``, ``no_rows``, ``indicator_values_unknown`` (an
indicator cell that is no direction word, or a signed amount beside
it), ``sign_unverified`` (nothing proves the sign and the table looks
like a card export, or its amounts say nothing: one sign only, or more
rows of money in than of money out), ``indicator_contradicts_sign``
(direction words and the amounts' signs disagree) and
``investment_columns`` (a security, a quantity and a price column:
trades, not a cash ledger) and ``no_header`` (the table has no header
row, ``spec.has_header`` is false, and its columns were read from the
shapes of their cells with no running balance to prove them).
``activity_type_unknown`` is a brokerage
activity suggestion with actions PerFin does not type.
``sign_evidence`` is ``activity`` for an activity-mode suggestion
(amounts keep their own signs), else ``debit_credit``, ``indicator``,
``balance``, ``indicator_correlation`` (direction or transaction-type
words that go with the signs of the amounts) or null (signed amounts
read as "positive is money in" on trust).
MappingSuggestionOut.title: MappingSuggestionOut

MappingUpdate.description:
``PATCH /imports/mappings/{id}``: only the named fields change.

``null`` clears ``account_id`` / ``institution_id``; ``document_id`` (or
``header_fingerprint``) recomputes (sets) the fingerprint.
MappingUpdate.title: MappingUpdate
